HeroSection.title: Covered Parking in Trapani, Near the Port
HeroSection.subtitle: Reserve secure parking in Trapani online and arrive ready for the port, the Egadi Islands, or Favignana—without driving around looking for a space.

AboutSection.title: About Green Parking
AboutSection.description: Green Parking offers convenient, secure parking in Trapani for cars and motorcycles. Reserve your covered parking space online before heading to the port, the Egadi Islands, or Favignana.
AboutSection.access247Desc: Access the parking facility 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for a convenient arrival or departure.
AboutSection.allVehiclesDesc: Our secure parking facility welcomes both cars and motorcycles.
AboutSection.securePaymentDesc: Pay securely online with Stripe or in person with cash upon arrival.
AboutSection.security24Desc: Surveillance cameras monitor the facility around the clock for added peace of mind.
AboutSection.coveredParkingDesc: A closed, covered facility helps protect your car or motorcycle from the weather.
AboutSection.showersDesc: Clean showers are available for your convenience after the beach or other activities.

PricingSection.title: Pricing
PricingSection.description: Clear parking prices in Trapani based on your vehicle type and stay duration, with no hidden fees.
PricingSection.longStayDiscountBefore: For reservations of one month or more,

ContactSection.title: Get in Touch
ContactSection.subtitle: Need secure, covered parking in Trapani near the port? Contact us for your visit to the Egadi Islands or Favignana.
